input.name: input
input.scaling: x / 127.5 - 1, applied to 0..255 pixel values after resizing

resize.aspect_ratio: not preserved: the whole frame is squashed to 224x224, no crop

input.orientation: apply EXIF orientation before resizing so the bunch is upright; the training crops carry no EXIF rotation
input.do_not: apply ImageNet mean/std — FastViT's normalisation is inside the graph

output.name: Identity
output.meaning: softmax probabilities, one per class, in labels.txt order; sum to 1
output.calibration: uncalibrated — report as 'model confidence', not probability of correctness
